source.text: tantrasāra, ekonaviṃśam āhnikam atha adharaśāsanasthānāṃ gurvantānām api maraṇasamanantaraṃ mṛtoddhāroditaśaktipātayogād eva antyasaṃskārākhyāṃ dīkṣāṃ kuryāt ūrdhvaśāsanasthānām api luptasamayānām akṛtaprāyaścittānām iti parameśvarājñā // abhts_19.1 tatra yo mṛtoddhāre vidhiḥ uktaḥ sa sarva eva śarīre kartavyaḥ pūrṇāhutyā śavaśarīradāhaḥ mūḍhānāṃ tu pratītirūḍhaye sapratyayām antyeṣṭiṃ kriyājñānayogabalāt kuryāt tatra śavaśarīre saṃhārakrameṇa mantrān nyasya jālakrameṇa ākṛṣya rodhanavedhanaghaṭṭanādi kuryāt prāṇasaṃcārakrameṇa hṛdi kaṇṭhe lalāṭe ca ity evaṃ śavaśarīraṃ kampate // abhts_19.2 tataḥ paramaśive yojanikāṃ kṛtvā tat dahet pūrṇāhutyā antyeṣṭyā śuddhānām anyeṣām api vā śrāddhadīkṣāṃ tryahaṃ turye dine māsi māsi saṃvatsare saṃvatsare kuryāt // abhts_19.3 tatra homāntaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā naivedyam ekahaste kṛtvā tadīyāṃ vīryarūpāṃ śaktiṃ bhogyākārāṃ paśugatabhogyaśaktitādātmyapratipannāṃ dhyātvā parameśvare bhoktari arpayet ity evaṃ bhogyabhāve nivṛtte patir eva bhavati antyeṣṭimṛtoddharaṇaśrāddhadīkṣāṇām anyatamenāpi yadyapi kṛtārthatā tathāpi bubhukṣoḥ kriyābhūyastvaṃ phalabhūyastvāya iti sarvam ācaret // abhts_19.4 mumukṣor api tanmayībhāvasiddhaye ayam jīvataḥ pratyaham anuṣṭhānābhyāsavat // abhts_19.5 tattvajñāninas tu na ko 'py ayam antyeṣṭyādiśrāddhānto vidhiḥ upayogī tanmaraṇaṃ tadvidyāsaṃtānināṃ parvadinaṃ saṃvidaṃśapūraṇāt tāvataḥ saṃtānasya ekasaṃvinmātraparamārthatvāt jīvato jñānalābhasaṃtānadivasavat // abhts_19.6 sarvatra ca atra śrāddhādividhau mūrtiyāgaḥ pradhānam iti śrīsiddhāmatam tadvidhiś ca vakṣyate naimittikaprakāśane // abhts_19.7

l1_text:
## tsa19-p01
Nineteenth ahnika. For lower-śāstra-standing teachers too, after death, from descent-arisen at death, one should do called last-sacrament-initiation — for upper-śāstra-standing lapsed samaya unexpiated too — so the Lord's command. (19.1) Therein, who in dead-lifting rite stated, that entirely in body to be done. By full-offering dead-body-burning. For fools, for appearance-rooting, marked last-rites by knowledge-yoga force one should do. Therein in dead-body, in dissolution-course mantras placed, by net-course drawn, binding-piercing-striking-and-the-rest done, through breath-course heart-throat-forehead — thus dead body trembles. (19.2) Then in supreme Śiva having made joining, that burn by full-offering. By last-rites, of pure or others too, or śrāddha-initiation, one should do, three days, fourth, monthly, yearly. (19.3) Therein, fire-offering-end rite done, food in one hand made, its vigor-formed power enjoyment-formed, in beast-enjoyment-power-identity-with contemplated, offered in Lord enjoyer — thus enjoyment-sense removed, Lord alone becomes — of last-rites-dead-lifting-śrāddha-initiation by any one, even though success, yet for enjoyment-wisher rite-muchness for fruit-muchness sake, thus one should do all. (19.4) For liberation-wisher too, for such-becoming-success, this of living daily practice-habituation-like. (19.5) For knowledge-possessors, not any of this last-rites-and-rest-and-śrāddha-end rite useful — for their death of knowledge-continuity-possessors is holy day — from consciousness-portion-filling, so much of continuity one-consciousness-only ultimate — as of living knowledge-gain continuity day. (19.6) Everywhere here in śrāddha-and-rest-rite is image-worship chief — so glorious Siddhāmata; that course will be stated in occasional manifestation. (19.7)

## tsa19-p01 — last rites for the unexpiated
The nineteenth chapter: even lower-śāstra teachers, when turned by descent at death, get the last-sacrament initiation — and upper-śāstra people with lapsed samaya and unperformed expiation too, by the Lord's command. The dead-lifting rite goes entirely in the body: full-offering burns the corpse; for fools, marked last-rites by knowledge-yoga force. In the corpse, dissolution-course mantras placed, net-drawn — binding, piercing, striking; breath-course through heart, throat, forehead — the corpse trembles. Then joining into supreme Śiva, burn it. By last-rites, for the pure or others, or śrāddha-initiation: three days, fourth, monthly, yearly. There: fire-offering-end rite done, food in one hand, its vigor-power, enjoyment-formed, in beast-enjoyment-power-identity contemplated, offered into the Lord-as-enjoyer — so enjoyment-sense removed, Lord alone becomes. Even one of last-rites/dead-lifting/śrāddha-initiation succeeding — still, for enjoyment-wishers, do much rite for much fruit. For liberation-wishers, the same daily, for such-becoming-success. For knowers, none of this is useful: their death is a holy day — consciousness-portion filling, continuity one-consciousness-only ultimate — as a living knowledge-gain continuity day. Everywhere here in śrāddha and rites, image-worship is chief — glorious Siddhāmata; its course in occasional manifestation.

The nineteenth chapter: even lower-śāstra teachers, when turned by descent at death, get the last-sacrament initiation — and upper-śāstra people with lapsed samaya and unperformed expiation too, by the Lord's command. The dead-lifting rite goes entirely in the body: full-offering burns the corpse; for fools, marked last-rites by knowledge-yoga force. In the corpse, dissolution-course mantras placed, net-drawn — binding, piercing, striking; breath-course through heart, throat, forehead — the corpse trembles. Then joining into supreme Śiva, burn it. By last-rites, for the pure or others, or śrāddha-initiation: three days, fourth, monthly, yearly. There: fire-offering-end rite done, food in one hand, its vigor-power enjoyment-formed, in beast-enjoyment-power-identity contemplated, offered into the Lord-as-enjoyer — so enjoyment-sense removed, Lord alone becomes. Even one of last-rites/dead-lifting/śrāddha-initiation succeeding — still, for enjoyment-wishers, do much rite for much fruit. For liberation-wishers, the same daily, for such-becoming-success. For knowers, none of this is useful: their death is a holy day — consciousness-portion filling, continuity one-consciousness-only ultimate — as a living knowledge-gain continuity day. Everywhere here in śrāddha and rites, image-worship is chief — glorious Siddhāmata; its course in occasional manifestation.

The passage moves in seven steps. (1) Eligibility: lower-śāstra-standing + end + death-moment descent → antyasaṃskāra-initiation (Lord's command); upper-standing lapsed/unexpiated too. (2) Dead-lifting rite entirely in body: full-offering burns corpse; for fools, marked last-rites by knowledge-yoga force. (3) In corpse: dissolution-course mantras placed; net-drawn (binding/piercing/striking); breath-course heart/throat/forehead → corpse trembles. (4) Then in supreme Śiva joining, burn; full-offering; pure/others' śrāddha-initiation (3 days/fourth/monthly/yearly). (5) Fire-offering-end rite, food in one hand, vigor-power enjoyment-formed, beast-enjoyment-power-identity contemplated, offered in Lord enjoyer → enjoyment-sense removed, Lord alone becomes. (6) Even one succeeding — still, for enjoyment-wishers, much rite for much fruit; for liberation-wishers, daily for such-becoming. (7) For knowers, none useful: death = holy day (consciousness-portion filling, continuity one-consciousness-only ultimate); image-worship chief (Siddhāmata); course in occasional manifestation.
